title: Shared observer retry fairness and failure isolation

current_assessment: A source poll serves at most 24 due retry records, at most two per route, in fixed route order. title: External source witnesses retain correlated-provider trust
original_cause: External-source signing historically depended on a provider view that honest BLS validators could share. Requiring two labelled operators removed the single-counted-witness failure mode but left correlated or colluding providers and their upstreams inside the trust boundary.
current_assessment: Each witness supplies the complete receipt/message/route/fee view from one endpoint; the comparison requires the exact source block hash and all relevant operation fields. original_cause: Read-side witness RPC gained deadlines and worker-scope cancellation, but external membership and governance submissions construct a separate legacy transaction relayer. Its receipt timeout controls the interval between polls, not a bound on each preflight/send/receipt network call.
current_assessment: Both current external submission paths select a verified URL and then construct NewTxRelayer with only address and polling interval.
